clothModel: skeletal reference with regional implicit secondary cloth
jumpFraming: uses vertical envelope of the actual retained native jump clip
linearSolve: fused three-axis graph access; stop only at an unchanged full sweep; original scalar 8 sweeps retained for QA
facePassRouting: same-frame full beauty depth, two native-skin-only auxiliary passes
demonstration: live walk/run/jump driven by committed simulation time
samplingPolicy: screen error hysteresis; stationary camera motion never repeatedly coarsens
workerScheduling: next fixed-step deadline; monotonic actual wall target; no discarded time
shadowPolicy: primary key shadows; colored rim and neutral fill retained
rejectedLiveSnapshotInterpolation: extra main-thread cost; not used in the released runtime
denimCrimpSampling: continuous projected error; eight initial segments per 48 mm; even cross sections at least six sides
denimDraftFilter: separable pixel box coverage of the original discrete 4x4 3:1 draft; not continuous stripes
denimBleachPigmentChannels: blue warp, pale neutral weft, material-space dye loss
userFeedbackAddressed: light denim was too flat; retain yarn normals, visual relief and cotton sheen
denimBleachFilteredRelief: screen-pixel-integrated first-band 3:1 float normals plus original macro yarn geometry
denimFarFilter: continuous screen-footprint Nyquist fade of draft colour and relief; unresolved strand highlights converge to cloth normal; dye-loss and roughness noise filtered separately
